title: Strict DVR quotient transport before total derived coefficient limit
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, an adic datum d on its valuation ring, a scheme T, the canonical coefficient model C of [def-sf-open-quotient-koszul-models], and a normalized reduction/limit calculus S of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. There is a natural isomorphism from completed-adic reduction after C.derived to scalar-restricted S.reduction followed by C.towers. For each flat-term K-flat Q, a single strict tensor tower B and augmentation a from the constant Q admit the comparisons kappa, e and tau of OpenDvrStrictReductionComparison. They satisfy the ordinary unit equation, the reduction-counit equation, identification of the strict augmentation with unrestrictedTowerUnit at all levels, and the total-limit formula identifying S.adjunction.unit with localization of the ordinary compatible-family map followed by the universal right-derived comparison. These are exactly the tower and representative fields of OpenDvrStrictReductionComparison. No derived coefficient-limit comparison is supplied and no reconstruction-completion-unit identity is asserted.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition), and 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok); strict tensor transport step of lem-sf-open-dvr-augmented-reduction-comparison.

proof.text: Take the existing ordinary model M and the normalized left-derived comparison epsilon for the specified S from ordinaryModel_exists and fixedDerivedComparison, using the canonical termwise limit comparison and canonical right-derived unit. Apply ordinary DVR tensor transport to M, giving the ordinary natural tensor comparison nu and strict tower identification kappa.

Apply the already proved openDvrDerivedTowerComparison to nu and epsilon. Its comparison on flat-term K-flat resolutions supplies the natural tower isomorphism t and its exact representative counit square. In the representative take e to be exact restriction of epsilon followed by its localization factor, and tau to be nu on complexes; their hom maps are definitionally those of that square.

For Q choose the actual termwise tensor complex I=M.quotient Q, its exact restricted tower complex B, and the explicitly constructed ordinary constant/limit adjunct a. The derived representative is exact restriction of epsilon followed by mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Take tau from nu on complexes and kappa from ordinary transport. Their ordinary-unit and unrestrictedTowerUnit equations hold by construction. The normalized Hom equation of fixedDerivedComparison, evaluated on identity of I, is the S.unit formula. Compose it with the exact restriction localization factor; the inverse factor in systemLimitUnit cancels. The ordinary limit projection identities identify M.limitComparison with the termwise comparison after the composite-functor comparison. Apply the const/limit Hom equivalence to a, then cancel the termwise comparison against its inverse in the canonical limit unit. The resulting equation is exactly localization of the ordinary compatible-family map followed by derivedLimitComplexComparison. Apply C.derived.functor and its map_comp equation. This proves the last representative clause without using derived-limit projections to detect equality. The already proved openDvrScalarUnitFormula packages the ordinary adjunction and localization cancellations in a separate module.
